summary: Created a 7-phase plan for phases 9-10 of the parent restore: fix the flagged stale builder/module.py import of deleted output components + CLI smoke tests; root-cause the 5 relocated cross-oracle differential failures (3 self-contained semantic-divergence cases, 2 BimodalHarness-dependent skips); confirm in-package bimodal green sans harness; establish a full-suite green gate under pytest-xdist. Wall-clock is handled by backgrounding each heavy run once with --junitxml and composing the full tally (bimodal run + everything-else run) so the ~70-min bimodal suite is never re-run.
decisions_made: Missing SequentialSaveManager/ConsoleInputProvider were intentionally deleted (commit 71ef79a1); fix prunes the dead module.py sequential-save path rather than restoring them.
Full-suite gate is composed from a dedicated bimodal run plus an --ignore-bimodal remainder run to avoid re-running the ~70-min bimodal suite.
Heavy pytest-xdist runs are serialized into separate waves to avoid core oversubscription; all source edits land before any backgrounded run.
